From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@cloudbridge.com>

Subject: Redwood x CloudBridge - Partner-led discovery follow-up

Hi Marissa / Mateo,

Great to run through the high-level discovery with the team earlier - thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next step:

- Objective: confirm technical integration path for CloudBridge marketplace listing (authentication, artifacts, metrics ingestion, billing mapping).
- Key questions we still have: model packaging requirements, KV cache persistence during warm starts, and footprint limits for the marketplace image.

We think the best next step is a 60-minute technical deep dive/demo with Redwood infra + your solutions engineer(s) + our marketplace/engineering leads. Proposed slots (PST):
  - Thu 12 Feb, 11:00-12:00
  - Thu 12 Feb, 15:00-16:00

If you can confirm a slot, I can send a calendar invite and a short prep sheet for the demo. I attached our high-level integration overview (CloudBridge-integration-overview.pdf).

Participants from our side: Sophie (partner lead), Ryan Cho (marketplace engineer), Marketplace team alias (marketplace@cloudbridge.com).

Thanks - looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Sophie Tan
Partnerships, CloudBridge
[sophie's mobile redacted]
